title: Vampire Vape Koncept Heisenberg 100ml Shortfill E-Liquid
description: Get ready to indulge in a supersized version of the Vampire Vape Heisenberg flavour that put Vampire Vape on the map and revolutionised the world of vaping by introducing a completely new e-juice flavour with the 100ml Vampire Vape Koncept Heisenberg Shortfill E-Liquid. This moreish Heisenberg by Vampire Vape Shortfill Liquid offers a rich, juicy blend of sweet, crushed sharp Red Berries, infused with an invigorating blast of menthol for maximum refreshment. This Vampire Vape Koncept Heisenberg Shortfill E-Liquid is perfect for any vaper looking to enjoy a truly one-of-a-kind vaping experience. Every 100ml Heisenberg Shortfill bottle offers a truly unique and satisfying vape indulgence that you won’t want to miss out on, thanks to its intricate and flavourful blend. With its complex and rewarding flavour profile, this Vamprire Vape Koncept Shortfill e-juice is sure to become a staple in any vaper's collection.Don't let your taste buds miss out. Order a bottle of this delicious Vampire Vape Koncept Heisenberg today, or sink your fangs into the equally delicious Vampire Vape Blood Sukka Koncept to immerse yourself in the ultimate vape experience. The Vampire Vape Koncept range brings delicious 50ml and 100ml Shortfills to their celebrated collection, offering Sub-Ohm vapers significantly longer-lasting versions of some of Vampire Vape’s most iconic E-Liquids. All your favourite vape juice flavours are here, including the legendary juices Pinkman and Heisenberg.Every bottle of this moreish Vampire Vape Koncept Shortfill 100ml collection contains 100ml of E-Liquid in a 120ml Shortfill bottle, with space for 2 x 10ml Nicotine Shots to let you tailor your e juice’s nicotine content to allow discerning vapers like yourself to create a personalised nicotine level and vape experience to suit your vaping needs. For example, adding 2 x 10ml, 18mg Nic Shots will create 120ml of delicious Vampire Vape Koncept 3mg E-Liquid. These moreish Vampire Vape Koncept Shortfill E-Liquids contain a ratio of 70VG/30PG making them ideal for use with higher-powered vape kits and pod kits, as most of these devices will use a coil below 1.0ohm (Sub-Ohm) resistance. At lower resistances, coils are better equipped to handle the thicker VG ingredient of the E-Liquid, and produce satisfying, dense clouds with fantastic flavour. If you love this moreish Vampire Koncept 100ml Shortfill, then why not sink your fangs into the equally delicious Vampire Vape 10ml E-Liquid collection. These 10ml Liquids are available in varying nicotine strengths and bursting with luscious vape juice flavours, making them a great way to soothe nicotine cravings. Check out the Vampire Vape E-Liquid 10ml and Vampire Vape Nicotine Salts here today.
